items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Benny called. He said, “Hey, Jim, we saw you on television.”

ctx.x: Yeah. They’ve been living in France for years. So Benny called. He said, “Hey, Jim, we saw you on television.” I said, “Oh, great.” And he said, “Yeah, you weren’t playing. You were, you were putting down the American government.” So I said, “Oh, right. I made it.” (laughs)
